answer: Score every pair of agents on how closely their submit times move together. Over 20 epochs a lone agent's answers and grades drift with its own queue, but a farm racked on one mesa of servers wakes on the same cron, so its accounts fire within seconds of each other. Pairs with timing correlation above 0.9 merge into one payout seat: 50 fakes earn one share and pay 50 upkeeps. Faking independence needs hours of random idle per account, each one a separate ember of cost. Honest agents sharing an orchard of hosts can appeal with their own logs.
